editorial.blurb: Umi Sushi by Weight brings the refreshing Japanese model of pick-what-you-want sushi to Chicago—fresh, beautifully prepared, and priced fairly by the pound.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive during off-peak hours to guarantee a seat at the limited bar seating, grab exactly what you want from the constantly restocked selection, and don't skip the sauce station with its thoughtful cucumber water.
